definitions.explanation: A tall plant with large yellow flowers that turn to follow the sun.

notes:
The name {向日葵|ひまわり} literally says 'facing the sun' (⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ + ⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧ + ⟦{葵|あおい}→葵：noentry⟧), after the way young plants track the ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧. Usually written ヒマワリ in botanical contexts and ひまわり in everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {向日葵|ひまわり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧ - sunflowers bloom
- {向日葵|ひまわり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒔|ま}く→蒔く：02419_maku⟧ - to sow sunflower seeds
- {向日葵|ひまわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ - to grow sunflowers

COMPOUNDS:
- {向日葵|ひまわり}⟦{畑|ばたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧ (sunflower field, a summer sightseeing destination)
- {向日葵|ひまわり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧ (sunflower seeds, sold as a snack and as birdseed)
- ひまわり⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧ (sunflower oil)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The flower stands for ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ itself, and for brightness and energy; it is a stock image in school art and summer advertising. Large planted fields such as those in ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧ draw tourists in August. The name ひまわり is also widely used for nursery schools, clinics, and welfare services, where the sunny associations are the point.
